title: Classification
description: Empirical verdict for one mechanic trace comparison (plan §7: 5-way enum + loss text + evidence refs). Produced by compare_lanes.py from two normalized streams.

mechanic.description: Short mechanic identifier matching the slice name (e.g. 'taphold', 'doublepress', 'simpress')

loss_text.description: Human-readable description of the behavioral loss for non-exact verdicts; null for exact

jsm_summary.description: Brief description of JSM-lane behavior relevant to this verdict

steam_summary.description: Brief description of Steam-lane behavior relevant to this verdict

evidence_refs.description: Relative paths to supporting artifacts (capture files, normalized JSONs, run result.md, findings files)

notes.description: Optional extended notes or open questions
